proposals.title: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision — Principles for Operational Resilience (March 2021, final publication)
proposals.use: International method context for critical operations, dependencies, scenario exercises, incident learning and defensive ICT controls; no national-law conclusion or source-prescribed Cedar threshold.
proposals.verification: Actual final 12-page PDF reopened. Inspected printed pp. 3–8: definitions and tolerance; governance, control/change and continuity principles; dependency/third-party mapping; incident response and learning; ICT principle and paragraphs37–38 on access, integrity, backups and testing. This is the final March2021 text, not the earlier consultation. Original queue, loss and deployment calculations are independent teaching constructions.

verification_of_reuse: Independently reopened official SR26-2 letter dated17April2026 and its actual12-page interagency PDF. Rechecked letter supersession of SR11-7/SR21-8, guidance-versus-enforceable-standards distinction, scope/model definition and excluded tools, and SectionsIII–VII on effective challenge, use, validation/monitoring, governance and vendor products. These source publications predate the edition boundary; no institution-specific applicability or compliance claim is made.
original_material: All Cedar data, capacities, failure probabilities, control thresholds, duplicate-loss convention, model fit, proofs, exercises and closure gates are original synthetic material.
